Samsung Vision AI is here

The view zooms through curving structures like glaciers that are blue tinged with yellow. The view arrives at a fantastic field of pink and orange grass and bushes. Cut to an aerial view of clouds and waves. The clouds partly clear up to reveal an otherworldly blue landscape with fog and swirls.

intelligent solutions that enrich everyday life.
We’re redefining what screens can do — simplifying,

Upscale your every moment

Front-row experiences

AI Upscaling

Samsung Vision AI makes your everyday content feel cinematic. AI Picture3 enhances resolution for breathtaking
sharpness and detail. AI Sound3 fine-tunes the audio, delivering crystal-clear dialogue and immersive sound.
AI Optimization3 intelligently adjusts settings to match your content and environment.

A man and a boy play basketball. AI detects several points in the scene for upscaling. Waves of tiny diamonds appear from these points and sweep across the screen. The scene becomes clearer and more vivid. The view zooms out to reveal that it's a scene being played on a TV screen.

Extraordinary together

SmartThings

Pet Care

Samsung Vision AI enhances your everyday life by
unlocking new SmartThings features. Stay connected to your loved ones with
Pet Care4, ensuring peace of mind even when you’re away.

Universal Gestures

Samsung AI TVs also recognize Galaxy Watch's
Universal Gestures5 for quick, easy use — like rotating the watch's bezel to scroll the TV screen, or making a fist to return to the previous screen.

It’s your show

Personalized experiences

Generative Wallpaper

What's your mood for
the day? What appeals to you?

There's even a new way to visually express yourself. Every day, you can enter keywords into your TV that reflect your mood.
With Generative Wallpaper6, your TV will create stunning backgrounds that match those vibes.

A woman is surrounded by bubbles with prompts like Party Mood, Lonely, Nature, Happy Holiday, Chill hour, Relax, Nostalgic, Excited, Deco, Seize your day, Inspire me and Serene. The bubbles are replaced by images of scenery. An AI-generated content image of a rainbow and snowy mountains is selected.

Bixby

Our AI voice assistant is here to help

Do you have questions to ask or ideas to share? Bixby7, our AI voice assistant, is here to help. With Samsung Vision AI,
it understands the context better, making conversations smoother and offering more useful support.

* Global No.1 TV: Source –Omdia, Feb-2025. Results are not an endorsement of Samsung. Any reliance on these results is at the third-party’s own risk.

* Available functions and content may vary depending on the model, country/region and are subject to change without notice.

* Image simulated for illustrative purposes. Sequences shortened and simulated. Actual UI may be different.

  1. One UI Tizen: Content and services may vary by region and are subject to change without notice. Agreement to Smart Hub Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy is required before use. Some content and services require registration and subscription. Requires Samsung account. Tizen OS upgrades will be provided for up to 7 years, starting from release year. Please note that this upgrade does not cover the TV’s hardware performance, features or durability. Upgraded features may vary depending on the specifications and model. Requires internet connection. Data charges may apply.
  2. Samsung Knox Security: Samsung Knox Security applies to Samsung TVs powered by Tizen®, launched since 2015. Latest software update is required.
  3. AI Picture, AI Sound, AI Optimization: Viewing experience may vary according to types of content and format. Upscaling may not apply to PC connection and Game Mode.
  4. Pet Care: Real-time streaming on mobile devices is supported on mobile devices with Android OS 11.0 and higher versions or iOS 16.0 and higher versions, and 2025 Samsung TVs and later models. It only works when the TV is turned off. TV must be connected to a power source to use this feature. TV and mobile device must be connected to SmartThings by same Samsung account to send and receive notifications.
  5. Universal Gestures: Available apps and services may vary and are subject to change without notice. Only supported on Galaxy Watch4 and later models, with Wear OS 5 and higher versions.
  6. Generative Wallpaper: The number of generation attempts allowed per day may be limited. The image depicted on the TV screen is AI-generated images created through the Generative Wallpaper function. This feature is not supported on OLED models. This feature is not supported in China.
  7. Bixby: Voice commands and multi turn are supported for 10 languages (US/UK/IN(en)/DE/FR/IT/ES/BR/MX/KR). Not all accents, dialects and expressions recognized. Q8F and above support far-field mics. Q7F and above support TV remotes. U8000F needs a SmartThings mobile remote.
